jobs.title: Business Development Specialist (Supply)
jobs.description:
💙 ABOUT BOUNCE...

Bounce is building cloud storage for the physical world, starting with the largest global luggage storage network in existence. Bounce’s marketplace connects travelers with 30,000+ small business locations worldwide for hyper-local short term baggage storage. With more locations globally than Burger King, and more locations in New York City than Starbucks, Bounce has served 3M+ users and stored 10M+ bags, and paid over $10M to small business partners.

To achieve this, Bounce is a fast-paced and scrappy team. We believe that experimentation fuels innovation, so we move quickly, testing new ideas and adapting in real time. If you’re ready to make an impact in a high-energy, close-knit, and collaborative environment - Bounce is the place where you can move fast, think big, and shape the future of travel. Join us as we make the world a lighter, more accessible place! Bounce has been named the Inc5000’s fastest-growing travel company in the USA in 2024 and is proudly backed by leading Silicon Valley investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, General Catalyst, and Sapphire. (Learn more about Bounce's Series B HERE https://techcrunch.com/2024/11/12/bounce-grabs-19m-to-expand-its-traveller-convenience-network/ and also learn about our Japan Expansion HERE https://techcrunch.com/2024/11/12/bounce-grabs-19m-to-expand-its-traveller-convenience-network/)




ABOUT THE ROLE...

Bounce is hiring a Business Development Specialist (Supply), you will be responsible for signing businesses onto Bounce’s platform and covering the US market, by doing a combination of inside and outside sales activities. 




WHERE YOU COME IN...

 - You will grow Bounce’s network and close supply gaps in the US

 - You will be expected to cold call, email, and outreach to prospective clients

 - Work closely with your manager to identify areas for expansion

 - You are supplied with leads every month, but you are expected to deliver your own leads

 - You are responsible for the full cycle of the sales from discovery call, sales pitch, close, creating the account, to onboarding the partner 




YOUR PROFILE

 - Experience with full cycle sales in a startup environment, selling to small businesses is required

 - High-energy individual with a strong desire to learn and achieve top results

 - Comfortable with a high volume of sales calls & confidence in cold approaching businesses

 - Comfortable with rejection / hearing "no"

 - Charismatic, positive, “can-do” attitude over the phone and in-person

 - Excellent communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills

 - Strong work ethic who’s looking to contribute directly to the company’s success

 - Confidence in face-to-face interaction and outside sales with local businesses

 - Self-starter with the drive to self-manage and work towards goals

 - Interest in Sales, Marketing, and startups

jobs.title: Partnerships Sales Intern
jobs.description:
💙 ABOUT BOUNCE

Bounce is building cloud storage for the physical world. We started with the largest luggage storage network on the planet: 35,000+ local businesses in 4,000 cities across 100+ countries, where travelers can drop their bags and get on with their day. Now we're expanding into luggage delivery and our own 24/7 lockers.

We're a small, scrappy team with offices in Lisbon, San Francisco, and Tokyo. We move fast, test ideas early, and change course when the data tells us to. If you want to help make the world a lighter place, you'll fit right in.

Bounce was named the Inc 5000's fastest-growing travel company in the USA in 2024 and is backed by leading Silicon Valley investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, General Catalyst, and Sapphire.




ABOUT THE ROLE


As Bounce's Partnerships Intern, you'll join our Partnerships team for 6 months and help drive demand growth through our affiliate program. You'll build relationships with businesses that put Bounce in front of travelers, and turn each one into a partner that regularly sends bookings our way. You'll own your own market, work a daily pipeline, and be mentored one-to-one by one of the two people who built this channel at Bounce. By the end of the program you'll have run hundreds of partner conversations, negotiated commercial terms, and have a track record you can point to.

Start date: January 2027

Duration: 6 months 



WHERE YOU COME IN

 - You own partner acquisition in your market, from the first conversation to activation, to the partner's first booking

 - You work a daily pipeline of leads that arrive already researched and qualified, so your time goes into conversations, not spreadsheets

 - You run the discovery call, work out whether there's a real fit, and follow up when people don't pick up first time

 - You negotiate commercial terms, onboard the partner and make sure they're actively sending bookings to Bounce

 - You're accountable for partners that produce, not partners you simply sign. Your target is clear: 100 new producing partners over the six months

 - You log every conversation, because decisions about the programe are made on the data you collect

 - You work closely with your mentor and manager, who qualified every lead you call and coach you on the ones that go wrong




YOUR PROFILE

 - You're fluent in English, and fluent in Portuguese, French or Italian

 - Some commercial experience is a plus, though not required (an internship or otherwise)

 - You're confident on the phone and at volume, and you stay resilient when most calls go unanswered

 - You can hold a credible, professional conversation with business owners and operations leads. These are commercial conversations with people running real businesses

 - You're organized enough to work a list in order rather than cherry-picking, and honest enough to log the calls that went badly

 - You're curious about why a "no" happens, and use it to get better

 - Nice to have: experience in travel, hospitality, or any partnerships or B2B background




INTERVIEW PROCESS

 1. Intro call with our Talent team to get to know you and share more about Bounce.

 2. Team interview to explore your background and skills 

 3. Final interview with our Partnerships Manager 




COMPENSATION & BENEFITS 

Compensation

 - €900 per month 

 - Commission (100% of target = €315 per month)

Benefits 

 - Meal allowance through Coverflex

 - Commute allowance

 - Gym membership

 - Catered lunches twice a week, plus snacks and drinks in the office




LOCATION 

You'll be based in our Lisbon office https://maps.app.goo.gl/J3JKiKMVaA2sghEg7.
